notes: The bundled Depth Anything V2 Small Q4 model is models/model_q4.onnx. Camera RGBA is explicitly resized and converted to ImageNet-normalized RGB/NCHW; Tensor.fromImage is not used because it does not resample ImageData buffers. Dynamic input follows the DPT 518px aspect-preserving processor contract and output is read as authoritative row-major HxW. The shell is network-first and versioned to prevent mixed-build boot graphs.
